title: THE ITEM IN HAND STANDS ABOVE THE CHIPS
why: The cloud review of 2026-10-15 (finding 7) and the HUD spec: the pieces above the belt overlapped. The power-up timer chips (a row just over the belt keys) and the extraction lines (the headline and the arrow over them) were drawn straight through the item in hand plate whenever a power-up ran or an extraction was called while an item was readying. The pieces now tell the HUD registry where they drew, and the item in hand plate stands above whichever of them was up the frame before.
now: The item in hand plate now stands clear above the power-up chips and the extraction lines.

edits.replacement: var HUDREG={}, HUDPREV={};   // v16.xx (act1): HUDPREV, the registry of the frame before, for the pieces that give way to one drawn after them

edits.anchor: HUDREG={};   // v27.48 (hud1): this frame's registry starts empty
edits.replacement: HUDPREV=HUDREG; HUDREG={};   // v16.xx (hud1): this frame's registry starts empty; v16.xx (act1): the last one is kept
